# Board of Library Trustees Meeting Minutes

**Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 3:00 PM**

The meeting on October 7, 2026, was called to order at 3:00 PM by Joanne Geneva.

Present:

**Voting Members:**
- Joanne Geneva – Chair
- Peggy Blume – Secretary
- Sharon McCann-Kling – Member At Large

**Non-Voting Members:**
- Jim McQueen – Library Director
- Deb Griffin- Youth Services Librarian

The Trustees reviewed the minutes from the meeting held on September 9, 2026. Sharon made a motion to accept the minutes. Joanne seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.

## Sutton Free Public Library

## Youth Services Librarian Report

**Meeting: October 7, 2026**

### Programming:

For the month of October, we have 9 activities on the calendar with some activities repeating throughout the month. We have 2 special events on the calendar, a "Spooky" Story Time and the Boo Bash! The "Spooky" Story Time is on Wednesday October 21 at 10:30AM and it will begin with a story in the library followed by a trick or treating parade through the Town Hall. Boo Bash! is on Saturday October 24 in conjunction with the school Trunk or Treat event and the Oh My Gourd - Scarecrow and Pumpkin Festival on the Common. The library will have games and treats from 4 - 6pm. We also have plans to have a scarecrow on display for the festival on the Common so please come by and check out our chosen Nursery Rhyme (and vote for us!). Our collaborative event with Millbury Public Library in November (or Dinovember) is officially on the calendar and is accepting registrations. We will be welcoming Dinoman for an evening of dinosaurs at the Elmwood School in Millbury. The event combines paleontology, storytelling, and life sized inflatables! To continue with our popular This or That question, the recent question was Bats vs Parrots with Parrots winning 41 votes with Bats earning 33 votes. The current question is chocolate chip cookies vs apple cider donuts.

### Collection Development:

Weeding of Juvenile non fiction is in process, I have made it halfway through the Dewey Decimals system. Hopefully, it will be completed this month.

### Meetings:

- October 19: Friends meeting

*Peggy Blume* (handwritten signature)

### Other:

- To Do: begin professional development through Massachusetts Library System learning pathways
- To Do: add to Tween and Teen programming
- Continued work using social media to promote our programs and events
- To Do: the reorganization of the cabinets in the Meeting Room
- To Do: cleaning out the back closet in hopes to use space more efficiently
- To Do: meet with the elementary level Librarians in the Sutton Public Schools
- Continued investigation and communication with various facilitators about scheduling upcoming programs/activities

*Jim commented that the Dinovember event was very special as it was a collaboration with Millbury Public Library and the Elmwood School in Millbury. Deb explained the registration process. Joanne asked about age groups. Deb responded that 6-11 was the target age group.*

## Sutton Free Public Library

## Director's Report

**October 2026**

### Adult Programming:

Please see attached report for September 2026 program statistics. Adult programs scheduled for October include: Adult Coloring Club, Board Game Night, afternoon and evening book groups, Cribbage Club, Inner Calm in Fall Yoga, Knots and Thoughts Fiber Club, Sci-Fi and Fantasy Book Group, and Writing Group.

### FY 2027 State Aid:

The Annual Report Information Survey (ARIS) was submitted in August. The Financial Report, State Aid Application & Compliance Form, and budget documentation were submitted on September 9 (well in advance of the October 2 deadline). We met all requirements for certification by the Massachusetts Board of Library Commissioners (MBLC), meaning we will be eligible to receive our full allotment of State Aid ($24,531) in FY 2027. The tables below show the Municipal Appropriation Requirement (MAR) and Materials Expenditure Requirement (MER) in blue, compared with our actual figures (in green).

**MUNICIPAL APPROPRIATION REQUIREMENT (MAR)**

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| FY 2027 MAR | $272,696 |
| FY 2027 Total Appropriated Municipal Income (TAMI) | $300,895 |

**MATERIALS EXPENDITURE REQUIREMENT (MER)**

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Full-Compliance MER (based on FY 2026 TAMI) | $52,701 |
| FY 2026 Total Materials Expenditure | $55,538 |

Libraries meeting the requirements will be certified by the MBLC in three groups, in November, December, and January. I hope that Sutton will be in the first group because of how early we submitted our documents.

*State aid was discussed at length. Joanne commented that MAR and MER are minimum requirements for State aid. Sharon asked about the percentage of materials expenditures funded by the Town. Jim explained that for FY 2026, the books are closed and we know that percentage: 89%. For FY 2027, he gave a projection (83%), and it's that projection that is subject to change. Jim explained that it is too early to tell what the final expenditure on materials will be.*

### Employee Appreciation Luncheon:

Library staff were invited to the Town of Sutton employee appreciation luncheon hosted by Waters Farm on September 22. Several staff were able to attend, and we were grateful to be included.

### September Meetings and Training:

- Town of Sutton monthly department heads' meeting on September 2
- Meeting with OverDrive rep on September 8
- Friends of the Library meeting on September 14
- CW MARS Users Council meeting on September 22
- Town of Sutton special department heads' meeting on September 23

### Upcoming Holiday Closings:

- Columbus Day: Monday, October 12
- Veteran's Day: Wednesday, November 11
- Thanksgiving: Wednesday, November 25 (closing early at 6 p.m.)
- Thursday, November 26
- Friday, November 27

## Sutton Free Public Library

## Strategic Planning Update

**October 2026**

I've completed the community survey data analysis and am in the process of preparing a report. Joanne and I are scheduled to meet with consultant Katherine Adelberg on October 16 to review her report on the focus groups. The next step will be to begin drafting goals and objectives informed by the data we've collected.

*Joanne made a motion to adjourn the meeting at 3:34. Sharon seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.*

*The next meeting of the Library Board of Trustees will be held November 4 at 3:00 PM.*
